whyItMatters: The official dsh-market index (11430-star marketplace, DSH built-in Discover tab, plugin_market agent tool) gates entries on npm publication.
Before 2026-11-09 the plugin was absent from all 4872 index entries because npm was unpublished; the Awesome catalog PR merge did not cover this pipeline.
Listing makes the plugin searchable and one-click installable inside DSH itself, without requiring users to add a custom index source.
knownGap: metadata.keywords is empty, so market search can only match name, title, category and description; 4985 of 4985 index entries have empty keywords, so this is an upstream pipeline-wide limitation rather than an entry defect.
